response.sql: WITH city_counts AS (SELECT c.location AS city, COUNT(q.qualifyId) AS qualifying_count FROM circuits AS c LEFT JOIN races AS r ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId LEFT JOIN qualifying AS q ON q.raceId = r.raceId WHERE c.location IS NOT NULL GROUP BY c.location), city_shares AS (SELECT city, qualifying_count, 1.0 * qualifying_count / NULLIF(SUM(qualifying_count) OVER (), 0) AS share FROM city_counts), compared AS (SELECT city, qualifying_count, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS average_share FROM city_shares) SELECT city, qualifying_count, share, share - average_share AS above_average_share FROM compared WHERE share > average_share ORDER BY share DESC, city;

assumptions.assumption: Each distinct non-null circuits.location is a city; cities with no qualifying records count toward the average share.
